cues.en: I know those milk mustache commercials are a hit. I know you've been told that milk does a body good. But at some point, someone has to point out that the milk emperor has no clothes.
cues.zh: 我知道那些“牛奶胡子”广告很火。我知道有人告诉你，牛奶对身体有好处。但到了某个时候，总得有人指出：牛奶皇帝其实没穿衣服。

cues.en: In fact, we're doing it today, here on Healthcare Triage.
cues.zh: 事实上，我们今天就在 Healthcare Triage 节目里这么做。

cues.en: People, has it occurred to none of you that we're the only mammals on the planet who consume milk after the early childhood period? We're so obsessed with it that we steal the milk from other species in order to keep drinking it. Look, I'm all for breastfeeding. It's what all the other mammals do, and I believe that evidence shows that breastfeeding is good for infants.
cues.zh: 各位，你们难道没人想到过吗？我们是地球上唯一在幼儿期之后还喝奶的哺乳动物？我们太痴迷于它了，甚至去偷其他物种的奶来继续喝。听着，我完全支持母乳喂养。其他哺乳动物都这么做，而且我相信有证据表明母乳喂养对婴儿有益。

cues.en: I also understand that we likely breastfeed for a shorter duration than nature intended.
cues.zh: 我也明白，我们母乳喂养的时长很可能比大自然本意要短。

cues.en: And in those cases, giving kids milk based formula and cow's milk are fine. But after age two or so, or whenever the brain no longer needs the extra fat for development,
cues.zh: 在这些情况下，给孩子喝牛奶配方奶和牛奶都没问题。但到了两岁左右，或者当大脑不再需要额外脂肪来发育时，

cues.en: there's really no good reason for us to keep drinking the stuff. Think about human history. Before we domesticated animals, we were getting along without any other animal's milk. Lots of humans can't even drink milk because they're lactose intolerant.
cues.zh: 我们真的没有充分理由继续喝这东西。想想人类历史。在驯化动物之前，我们没有其他动物的奶也过得好好的。很多人甚至不能喝奶，因为他们乳糖不耐受。

cues.en: They do just fine. Here in The United States, there are recommendations all over the place trying to get kids and adults to limit their intake of calorie containing beverages,
cues.zh: 他们照样没事。在美国，到处都有建议试图让儿童和成年人限制摄入含热量的饮料，

cues.en: except milk. Milk gets a pass. In fact, lots of recommendations say that we should be drinking up to three cups of the stuff per day. Those three cups contain more than 240
cues.zh: 除了牛奶。牛奶却获豁免。事实上，很多建议说我们每天应该喝多达三杯这东西。这三杯含有超过 240

cues.en: calories and more than 36 grams of sugar. Ironically,
cues.zh: 卡路里和超过 36 克糖。讽刺的是，

cues.en: nonfat milk contains more sugar than whole milk. What's with these recommendations? Ostensibly, it's because we need the calcium for bone strength, because more milk from the calcium it contains will make your bones stronger.
cues.zh: 脱脂牛奶比全脂牛奶含糖更多。这些建议是怎么回事？表面上看，是因为我们需要钙来增强骨骼，因为牛奶含钙，喝更多牛奶会让你的骨骼更强壮。

cues.en: You know where this is going, right? To the research! In 2007,
cues.zh: 你们知道接下来要讲什么了吧？看研究！2007年，

cues.en: a meta analysis was published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition,
cues.zh: 《美国临床营养学杂志》发表了一篇荟萃分析，

cues.en: looking at calcium intake and the risk of fractures.
cues.zh: 探讨钙摄入量与骨折风险之间的关系。

cues.en: It included seven prospective cohort studies of more than one hundred and seventy thousand women and almost three thousand hip fractures. They found no association
cues.zh: 该分析纳入了七项前瞻性队列研究，涵盖超17万名女性和近3000起髋部骨折。他们发现，

cues.en: between total calcium intake and the risk of hip fracture. For men, they found five prospective cohort studies of more than 68,000
cues.zh: 总钙摄入量与髋部骨折风险之间毫无关联。针对男性，他们找到了五项前瞻性队列研究，涵盖超6.8万名

cues.en: men and more than 200 hip fractures. No association there either. They also found five clinical trials seeking to prove that improving calcium intake would prevent fractures.
cues.zh: 男性及200多起髋部骨折。同样没有任何关联。他们还找到了五项临床试验，试图证明增加钙摄入能预防骨折。

cues.en: More than 5,600
cues.zh: 超过5600名

cues.en: women and 1,000 men took part in these studies where they randomly got calcium supplementation or placebo.
cues.zh: 女性和1000名男性参与了这些研究，被随机分配补充钙剂或安慰剂。

cues.en: They looked at all kinds of fractures,
cues.zh: 他们考察了各种类型的骨折，

cues.en: and the calcium did nothing significant. There were four trials that looked specifically at hip fractures,
cues.zh: 而补钙并没有带来任何显著改善。其中有四项试验专门针对髋部骨折，

cues.en: and there they found that calcium supplementation
cues.zh: 结果发现，补充钙剂

cues.en: increased the risk of hip fracture.
cues.zh: 反而增加了髋部骨折的风险。

cues.en: Increased it! But maybe milk is different. In 2011,
cues.zh: 居然增加了！但也许牛奶不一样？2011年，

cues.en: a meta analysis was published in the Journal of Bone and Mineral Research.
cues.zh: 《骨与矿物质研究杂志》发表了一篇荟萃分析。

cues.en: Researchers tried to gather all prospective studies looking for an association between milk intake and the risk of developing a hip fracture. There were six studies that included data on more than a hundred and ninety five thousand women who sustained more than 3,500
cues.zh: 研究人员汇总了所有探究牛奶摄入与髋部骨折风险关联的前瞻性研究。其中有六项研究涵盖了超19.5万名女性的数据，记录了3500多起

cues.en: hip fractures.
cues.zh: 髋部骨折。

cues.en: Guess what? There was no association
cues.zh: 你猜怎么着？两者之间根本没有关联

cues.en: between milk intake and the risk of fracture. There were three studies of more than seventy five thousand men with one hundred and ninety five hip fractures.
cues.zh: 牛奶摄入量与骨折风险之间没有关联。有三项研究涉及超过七万五千名男性，其中发生了一百九十五例髋部骨折。

cues.en: Analyses again could not establish a statistically significant relationship.
cues.zh: 分析同样无法确立统计学上显著的关系。

cues.en: No proven protective effect of milk. To repeat,
cues.zh: 没有证据表明牛奶有保护作用。再说一遍，

cues.en: milk isn't going to stop you from breaking your hip. But there's a more recent study published in JAMA Pediatrics just earlier this year. It was a prospective cohort study of ninety six thousand men and women in the long standing Nurses' Health and Health Professionals follow-up study.
cues.zh: 牛奶并不能阻止你髋部骨折。但今年早些时候发表在《JAMA Pediatrics》上的一项更新的研究。这是一项前瞻性队列研究，涉及九万六千名男性和女性，来自长期的护士健康研究和卫生专业人员随访研究。

cues.en: They asked participants to rate their milk consumption as teenagers,
cues.zh: 他们让参与者评估自己青少年时期的牛奶消费量，

cues.en: and then followed them to see if they got hip fractures over the next twenty five years or so. Turns out that males who drank more milk as teens had a nine percent higher risk of having a hip fracture later in life. When height was added to the analytic model, the relationship wasn't significant anymore.
cues.zh: 然后对他们进行随访，看他们在接下来大约二十五年里是否发生髋部骨折。结果发现，青少年时期喝牛奶较多的男性，晚年发生髋部骨折的风险高出百分之九。当把身高加入分析模型后，这种关系就不再显著了。

cues.en: So the good news is that the milk isn't gonna hurt you, but it's not gonna help you either. Drinking too much milk can be awful for your gut.
cues.zh: 所以好消息是，牛奶不会伤害你，但也不会帮你。喝太多牛奶对你的肠道可能很糟糕。

cues.en: It makes it bleed.
cues.zh: 它会让肠道出血。

cues.en: Every single year of residency,
cues.zh: 在住院医师培训的每一年，

cues.en: I admitted at least one child who was drinking a ton of milk and had slowly bled from his or her GI tract to a level of anemia that would kill an adult. It was always shocking, and the parents were always horrified to hear that it was excessive milk consumption that had put their child in the hospital for an extended stay. Here's a news story,
cues.zh: 我至少收治过一个大量喝牛奶的孩子，他或她的胃肠道慢慢出血，导致贫血程度严重到足以让一个成年人丧命。这总是令人震惊，而父母听到是过量牛奶消费让孩子长期住院时，也总是惊恐万分。这里有一则新闻报道，

cues.en: or take the word of Duke University Health System.
cues.zh: 或者你可以听听杜克大学健康系统的说法。

cues.en: Cow's milk is low in iron, and can actually prevent iron from being absorbed from the diet. In addition, some children develop small amounts of bleeding from their intestines when they have too much cow's milk. Am I saying milk is evil? No!
cues.zh: 牛奶含铁量低，实际上还会阻碍饮食中铁的吸收。此外，有些孩子摄入过多牛奶时，肠道会出现少量出血。我是在说牛奶有害吗？不！

cues.en: It's an important part of a small child's diet, and you should listen to your doctor about your toddler's consumption.
cues.zh: 它是幼儿饮食的重要组成部分，关于学步期孩子的饮奶量，你应该听从医生的建议。

cues.en: Moreover, like most things in moderation, it's totally awesome.
cues.zh: 而且，和大多数东西一样，适量食用完全没问题。

cues.en: What else are you gonna drink with hot apple pie? How else are you gonna turn your bowl of life cereal into a delicious paste? An Oreo without milk is close to a sin. But at some point, in older children and adults, we should own that milk is a calorie laden beverage like many others. It holds no special place, and you don't need it. Phenomenal marketing and a lot of wisdom have convinced you otherwise.
cues.zh: 不然你还能拿什么配热苹果派？还能怎么把一碗Life麦片变成美味的糊糊？奥利奥不配牛奶简直近乎罪过。但在某些时候，对于大孩子和成年人来说，我们应该承认，牛奶和许多其他饮料一样，是一种富含热量的饮品。它并没有什么特殊地位，你也不需要它。出色的营销和大量所谓的智慧让你相信了相反的说法。

cues.en: Get over it.
cues.zh: 接受现实吧。
